query:
UPDATE bots
            SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now()
            FROM agent_configs
            WHERE agent_configs.bot_id = bots.id
              AND agent_configs.harness_id = $1
              AND bots.kind = 'owned'
              AND bots.deleted_at IS NULL
            RETURNING bots.id, bots.owner_user_id, bots.team_id
